version: SafeSeat Camera Integrated V5.3.2 ESP-NOW Verification-Safe
purpose: Mirror the final standalone V4.3.2 UNKNOWN-safe verification contract into the ESP-NOW camera runtime without changing the model, pose features, occupant lock, temporal filter, or wire protocol.

standalone_750_evidence_carried_forward.basis: Model/pose/temporal/occupant-anchor files are unchanged; this is a decision-contract sync, not model retraining.

limitations: The integrated ESP-NOW firmware has not been flashed/executed on the physical ESP32-S3 in this packaging environment.
Full-system acceptance still requires a Main Hub transaction test proving UNKNOWN/NOT_READY/PENDING never clears the suspected emergency.
The 750-image evidence is carried forward because the camera model and pose pipeline are byte-identical; V5.3.2 changes only the verification decision contract in the integrated runtime.
